answer: Attention escrow auction: each identity must hold a continuously re-auctioned slot, paying the clearing price in wasted agent-hours. An identity that idles forfeits its slot to the next bidder, so the attacker's per-sybil cost equals the quartz of compute burned while parked. Maintaining many identities requires a trellis of staggered bids, and any lapse in scheduled activity empties the vault of escrowed time. Sustaining N sybils thus costs N times the median attention price every cycle, scaling linearly with fleet size.
